title: Moving and Re-Registering a Snowsports School Booking: Notice, Fees and Limits
content:
Against every Snowsports School product the collective publishes whether the booking may be moved to another date, the notice in whole hours before the scheduled start of the first session by which a move must be recorded, the fee for the move, the number of times one booking may be moved, whether the booking may be re-registered to a different participant, and the fee for that re-registration.

| Product | Move to another date | Move notice (hours) | Move fee (USD) | Moves allowed | Re-registration | Re-registration fee (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | allowed | 24 | 25.00 | 1 | allowed | 15.00 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | allowed | 48 | 25.00 | 1 | allowed | 15.00 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | allowed | 48 | 25.00 | 1 | not allowed | 25.00 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | not allowed | 168 | 95.00 | 0 | not allowed | 95.00 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | allowed | 48 | 45.00 | 2 | allowed | 25.00 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | allowed | 72 | 75.00 | 2 | allowed | 35.00 |
| Elite Performance Camp | not allowed | 336 | 250.00 | 0 | not allowed | 150.00 |

## Notes on the figures

- Five products of the range carry a move to another date. Of those five, three allow one move and two allow two.
- The Six-Week Development Programme and the Elite Performance Camp do not carry a move, and both show 0 moves allowed.
- The move fee runs from 25.00 USD on the three products at that figure, through 45.00 USD and 75.00 USD, to 250.00 USD on the Elite Performance Camp.
- The re-registration fee runs from 15.00 USD on the two products at that figure, through 25.00 USD and 35.00 USD, to 95.00 USD and 150.00 USD on the two products that do not carry a re-registration.
- The move notice runs from 24 hours on the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson to 336 hours on the Elite Performance Camp.
